title: Character Spotlight Kit
description: Produced by stage 12 (optional). Direct-to-audience character videos made with HeyGen: per-video Director intake, in-character script, b-roll plan, and the SAVED HeyGen request payload — all recorded BEFORE generation (d-114). One entry per video; the stage loops until the Director closes it.

subject.description: The Director-given topic (introduce themselves, talk about the movie, tease the next episode, ...).

description.description: The Director's short description of what this video should be, captured in their words.

target_length_s.description: Director-chosen target length. Stage law: minimum 45 seconds.

cta.description: Call to action, if the Director wants one (subscribe, watch the film, ...).

char_id.description: lock_descriptors char_id of the speaking character.

source_image.description: Repo-relative path of the locked portrait / clean film frame animated by HeyGen.

heygen_avatar_id.description: HeyGen avatar/photo-avatar look id, when one was created for this character.

voice_plan.description: How this character's voice is produced (heygen voice_id, uploaded ElevenLabs audio, ...).

voice_id.description: HeyGen voice_id when TTS is used.

script.description: The full dialogue, in order. Written IN CHARACTER by the spotlight-writer and Director-approved ON PAPER before generation.

text.description: Exact spoken words (talking segments) or voiceover text (b-roll, optional).

clip_ref.description: Approved film clip used as b-roll (b_roll segments).

direction.description: Delivery/motion note (wink at camera, hold up the shrink ray, ...).

path.description: Which HeyGen route builds this video (see skills/tech/heygen).

payload.description: The COMPLETE HeyGen request payload(s), saved verbatim BEFORE the call (d-114).

asset_ids.description: Uploaded HeyGen asset ids keyed by local path.

cost_note.description: Stated cost/credits estimate announced at the gate.

output_path.description: Repo-relative path of the finished master (renders/spotlights/).

measured_length_s.description: ffprobe duration of the delivered master — must be >= 45.
